title.zh-CN: 智能推理平台

summary.zh-CN: 智能推理平台

overview.en-US: Xinference is an intelligent reasoning platform that utilizes advanced algorithms to analyze data, provide insights and decision support, and improve business efficiency.
overview.zh-CN: Xinference 是一个智能推理平台，利用先进算法分析数据，提供洞察和决策支持，提升业务效率。

description.en-US: Xinference is an advanced intelligent reasoning platform designed to help organizations make smarter decisions through data analytics and machine learning technologies. It is capable of processing large volumes of data and identifying patterns and trends to provide deep insights.Xinference's core features include real-time data processing, predictive analytics and automated reporting, allowing users to easily access critical information. The platform is applicable to multiple industries, including finance, healthcare and retail, helping companies optimize operations, reduce costs and enhance customer experience. With an intuitive interface and powerful algorithms, Xinference makes data-driven decision-making more efficient and accurate.
description.zh-CN: Xinference 是一个先进的智能推理平台，旨在通过数据分析和机器学习技术帮助企业做出更明智的决策。它能够处理大量数据，识别模式和趋势，从而提供深刻的洞察。Xinference 的核心功能包括实时数据处理、预测分析和自动化报告，用户可以轻松获取关键信息。该平台适用于多个行业，包括金融、医疗和零售，帮助企业优化运营、降低成本并提升客户体验。通过直观的界面和强大的算法，Xinference 使得数据驱动的决策变得更加高效和精准。

title.zh-CN: 可视化 Ansible/Terraform平台

summary.en-US: Modern UI for Ansible, Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, Pulumi.
summary.zh-CN: Ansible, Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, Pulumi 可视化平台

overview.en-US: Semaphore is a modern UI for Ansible, Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, Pulumi . It lets you easily run Ansible playbooks, get notifications about fails, control access to deployment system.
overview.zh-CN: Semaphore 是 Ansible、Terraform/OpenTofu、Bash 和 Pulumi 的现代 UI。它使您可以轻松运行 Ansible playbook，获取有关失败的通知，控制对部署系统的访问。

description.en-US:
Effortlessly manage the tasks with a modern, intuitive interface built for DevOps teams.

- Appears well on smartphones and tablets.
- The fewest steps required to accomplish any tasks.
description.zh-CN:
使用专为 DevOps 团队打造的现代直观界面，轻松管理任务。

- 在智能手机和平板电脑上显示效果良好。
- 完成任何任务所需的步骤最少。

overview.en-US: Run a shared QwenPaw Hub with per-user runtimes, isolated workspaces, skills, channels, and local or cloud models.

description.en-US:
QwenPaw (Qwen Personal Agent Workstation) is an open-source personal AI assistant from the AgentScope team. QwenPaw Hub is its multi-user control plane: team members sign in at one address, and each person gets a separate QwenPaw with its own workspace, settings, credentials, and conversations.

This package deploys QwenPaw Hub as a single control-plane container with the Local runtime backend. The Hub console is published on port 8088 and is seeded with a package-managed administrator account. The control database and every user runtime persist in the qwenpaw_data volume, and administrators can create accounts, manage runtimes, and control registration mode.

QwenPaw supports cloud model providers (DashScope/Qwen, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more) as well as local models through the built-in QwenPaw Local runtime, Ollama, or LM Studio. Extend it with Skills, Plugins, and MCP tools, and automate recurring work with built-in cron scheduling.

title.zh-CN: 数据流自动化和可视化，支持 ETL

summary.en-US: An easy to use, powerful, and reliable system to process and distribute data
summary.zh-CN: 数据流自动化和可视化，支持 ETL

overview.en-US: Apache NiFi is a powerful data flow management tool that supports data integration, processing, monitoring and visualization to simplify data flow.
overview.zh-CN: Apache NiFi 是一个强大的数据流管理工具，支持数据集成、处理、监控和可视化，简化数据流动。

description.en-US: Apache NiFi is an open source data flow automation tool designed to simplify the acquisition, processing and transfer of data. It provides a user-friendly interface that allows users to design data streams via drag-and-drop and supports a wide range of data sources and formats.NiFi's core features include visualization of data streams , real-time monitoring , data priority management and data routing . It is capable of handling large-scale data sets and supports data transformation, filtering and aggregation. In addition, NiFi is robustly secure and scalable for a variety of application scenarios such as IoT, data integration and real-time analytics.
description.zh-CN: Apache NiFi 是一个开源的数据流自动化工具，旨在简化数据的获取、处理和传输。它提供了一个用户友好的界面，允许用户通过拖放方式设计数据流，支持多种数据源和格式。NiFi 的核心特性包括数据流的可视化、实时监控、数据优先级管理和数据路由。它能够处理大规模数据集，并支持数据的转换、过滤和聚合。此外，NiFi 还具备强大的安全性和可扩展性，适用于各种应用场景，如物联网、数据集成和实时分析。

overview.en-US: This is NGINX container for HTML/JS Static website deployment, and it can also used for Proxy. NGINX is a high-performance web proxy server with excellent static resource and high concurrency processing capabilities.

summary.en-US: React web framework runtime and scaffold.

overview.en-US: Next.js runtime environment with a built-in scaffold workflow. Upload your project source, install dependencies automatically, build, and run it on the bundled Node runtime.

description.en-US:
Next.js is the React framework maintained by Vercel for building full-stack web applications with routing, rendering, data fetching, and deployment tooling. This package provides a self-hosted runtime environment for Next.js projects instead of a finished business app.

On first startup, if the mounted source directory is empty, the package scaffolds a default Next.js 16.3.5 project with create-next-app. When a user later uploads their own Next.js project source into the mounted app directory, the container automatically detects the package manager, installs dependencies, builds the project, and starts it with `next start`.

Typical use cases include development sandboxes, customer-owned runtime environments, internal app hosting, and managed self-hosting where users want to upload already-developed Next.js code and run it without preparing a custom Docker image first.

title.zh-CN: 团队内容与办公协作平台

summary.zh-CN: 团队内容与办公协作平台

overview.en-US: Nextcloud offers a modern, on-premises content collaboration platform with real-time document editing, Generative AI, video chat & groupware on mobile, desktop and web.
overview.zh-CN: Nextcloud提供了一个现代化的本地内容协作平台，具有实时文档编辑、视频聊天、生成式 AI 和群组软件功能，可在移动设备、桌面和网络上进行。

description.en-US:
Nextcloud Hub integrates the four key Nextcloud products Files, Talk, Groupware and Office into a single platform, optimizing the flow of collaboration. Eliminate the confusing hodgepodge of different SaaS tools and the compliance, security, cost and productivity issues that come with it and standardize on a single solution with Nextcloud Hub.

- Nextcloud Files offers a self-hosted file storage and sync platform with powerful collaboration capabilities with desktop, mobile and web interfaces
- Nextcloud Talk delivers on-premises, private audio/video conferencing and text chat through browser and mobile interfaces with integrated screen sharing and SIP integration
- Nextcloud Groupware integrates Calendar, Contacts, Mail and other productivity features to help teams get their work done faster, easier and on your terms.
- The first local AI assistant that is built into the Nextcloud Hub collaboration platform. Integrated across apps, it can generate content, answer questions about your data, summarize emails, translate, and much more.
description.zh-CN:
Nextcloud Hub 将 Nextcloud 的四个关键产品 Files、Talk、Groupware 和 Office 集成到一个平台中，从而优化了协作流程。消除不同 SaaS 工具的混乱大杂烩以及随之而来的合规性、安全性、成本和生产力问题，并使用 Nextcloud Hub 在单一解决方案上实现标准化。

- Nextcloud Files 提供了一个自托管的文件存储、编辑和同步平台，具有与桌面、移动和 Web 界面的强大协作功能
- 支持 Amazon S3、Dropbox、FTP、Google Drive、OpenStack Object Storage、SMB、WebDAV、SFTP 等其他文件同步来源
- Nextcloud Groupware 集成了日历、联系人、邮件和其他生产力功能，以帮助团队更快、更轻松、按照您的方式完成工作。
- Nextcloud Hub 协作平台中内置的第一个本地 AI 助手。它跨应用程序集成，可以生成内容、回答有关数据的问题、汇总电子邮件、翻译等等。

summary.zh-CN: 高性能的 NoSQL 图数据库

It is a high performance graph store with all the features expected of a mature and robust database. The programmer works with it can enjoying all the benefits of enterprise-quality database.
description.zh-CN: Neo4j 是一个高性能的 NoSQL 图数据库，用于存储数据关系，它也是一个嵌入式的、基于磁盘的、具备完全的事务特性的Java持久化引擎，它将结构化数据存储在网络上而不是表中。Neo4j也可以被看作是一个高性能的具有成熟数据库所有特性的图引擎。

summary.zh-CN: 开源 MLOps 平台

overview.en-US: Machine learning experiment management and model tracking tool with version control support.
overview.zh-CN: 机器学习实验管理和模型跟踪工具，支持版本控制。

description.en-US: MLflow is an open source platform for managing the machine learning lifecycle, including experiment tracking, project packaging, model management and deployment. It provides a simple API and user interface, supports multiple storage backends and deployment environments, and helps data scientists and machine learning engineers efficiently manage and reproduce experiments.MLflow consists of four main components: Tracking, Projects, Models, and Registry, and is designed to simplify complex machine learning workflows.
description.zh-CN: MLflow 是一个开源平台，用于管理机器学习生命周期，包括实验跟踪、项目打包、模型管理和部署。它提供了简单的 API 和用户界面，支持多种存储后端和部署环境，帮助数据科学家和机器学习工程师高效地管理和复现实验。MLflow 包括四个主要组件：Tracking（跟踪）、Projects（项目）、Models（模型）和 Registry（注册表），旨在简化复杂的机器学习工作流。

title.zh-CN: 向量数据库

summary.zh-CN: 开源 AI 向量数据库

overview.en-US: AI vector database that supports efficient similarity search and large-scale data management.
overview.zh-CN: AI向量数据库，支持高效相似搜索和大规模数据管理。

description.en-US: Milvus is an open source AI vector database designed for processing massive vector data. It supports efficient similarity search, vector indexing and large-scale data management, and is widely used in image retrieval, recommender systems, natural language processing, etc. Milvus provides a rich SDK and APIs, supports multiple programming languages, and is easy to integrate into various applications. Its high performance and scalability make it ideal for processing AI and big data applications.
description.zh-CN: Milvus 是一个开源的 AI 向量数据库，专为处理海量向量数据而设计。它支持高效的相似搜索、向量索引和大规模数据管理，广泛应用于图像检索、推荐系统、自然语言处理等领域。Milvus 提供了丰富的 SDK 和 API，支持多种编程语言，便于集成到各种应用中。其高性能和可扩展性使其成为处理 AI 和大数据应用的理想选择。

licenseadditional.en-US:
HAProxy is licensed under GPL 2 or any later version, the headers under LGPL 2.1.

HAPROXY's license - 2006/06/15

Historically, haproxy has been covered by GPL version 2. However, an issue
appeared in GPL which will prevent external non-GPL code from being built
using the headers provided with haproxy. My long-term goal is to build a core
system able to load external modules to support specific application protocols.

Since some protocols are found in rare environments (finance, industry, ...),
some of them might be accessible only after signing an NDA. Enforcing GPL on
such modules would only prevent them from ever being implemented, while not
providing anything useful to ordinary users.

For this reason, I *want* to be able to support binary only external modules
when needed, with a GPL core and GPL modules for standard protocols, so that
people fixing bugs don't keep them secretly to try to stay over competition.

The solution was then to apply the LGPL license to the exportable include
files, while keeping the GPL for all the rest. This way, it still is mandatory
to redistribute modified code under customer request, but at the same time, it
is expressly permitted to write, compile, link and load non-GPL code using the
LGPL header files and not to distribute them if it causes a legal problem.

Of course, users are strongly encouraged to continue the work under GPL as long
as possible, since this license has allowed useful enhancements, contributions
and fixes from talented people around the world.

Due to the incompatibility between the GPL and the OpenSSL licence, you must
apply the GPL/LGPL licence with the following exception:
This program is released under the GPL with the additional exemption that
compiling, linking, and/or using OpenSSL is allowed.

The text of the licenses lies in the "doc" directory. All the files provided in

description.en-US:
Consul is an open source tool developed by HashiCorp for service discovery and configuration management. It supports microservice architecture , can automate service registration and discovery , making the communication between services more efficient . Consul provides health checks to ensure that only healthy service instances are discovered and used . In addition, Consul supports multi-data center deployments, enabling service management in geographically diverse environments.

Key features of Consul include key-value stores, service grids, ACLs (access control lists), and API support for multiple languages. It can be integrated with other tools such as Kubernetes and Terraform to enhance infrastructure flexibility and manageability. With Consul, developers can more easily build and maintain complex distributed systems.

overview.en-US: Self-hosted workspace for designing prototypes, assets, and agent-driven creative projects with your team.

This Websoft9 package deploys the official `ghcr.io/nexu-io/od` image as a single container, following the upstream Docker deployment pattern. The package preserves persistent state in the `opendesign_data` volume mounted at `/app/.od` and enables the upstream health endpoint at `/api/health` for readiness checks.

Typical use cases include self-hosted AI design studios, collaborative prototyping teams, internal creative workspaces, and organizations that want to run OpenDesign with their own infrastructure and model credentials.

overview.en-US: Grav is a fast, flexible flat-file CMS with no database. This package runs the official Grav admin image.

description.en-US:
Grav is an open-source, modern flat-file CMS built on PHP. It stores content, configuration, and media as files instead of a database, which keeps the site portable and easy to back up and version.

Grav ships with a powerful Twig templating engine, Markdown-based content, and the Admin plugin for managing pages, themes, and plugins from the browser. This package deploys the LinuxServer.io Grav image with the Admin plugin included; the whole site, including user content and configuration, is persisted in a named volume mounted at /config.

Typical use cases include documentation sites, blogs, marketing sites, and small content-driven websites that want fast page loads and a simple, self-hosted setup without running a database.

title.zh-CN: Langfuse

summary.zh-CN: AI 可观测平台

overview.en-US: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and metrics. This package self-hosts Langfuse v4 with PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, and MinIO.
overview.zh-CN: Langfuse是一个开源的大型语言模型（LLM）工程平台。它助力团队协作开发、监控、评估和调试AI应用。Langfuse可快速实现本地部署，且经过实战验证。

description.en-US:
Langfuse is an open-source observability and analytics platform for LLM applications and AI agents. It captures traces of prompts, completions, tool calls and agent steps, supports datasets and evaluation runs, manages prompts and versions, and exposes usage, cost and latency metrics for production monitoring.

This package self-hosts the official Langfuse v4 docker-compose topology: the langfuse-web and langfuse-worker services together with PostgreSQL 17 for transactional data, ClickHouse for analytics, Redis 7 for the queue and cache, and MinIO for blob storage. Only the web console is published; the supporting stores stay on the internal app network.

Typical use cases include debugging and tracing LLM and agent applications, running evaluations and prompt experiments, monitoring token usage and cost, and giving teams a self-hosted alternative to hosted observability platforms.
description.zh-CN: Langfuse是一个专为大型语言模型（LLM）工程设计的开源平台，旨在帮助开发者高效创建和优化AI模型。该平台提供模型训练、评估与部署工具，让用户能够在各类应用中充分利用AI能力。平台支持可定制的工作流程，促进团队协作并提升生产力。凭借其用户友好的界面和详尽的文档，Langfuse致力于推动AI开发的普及化，既适合资深开发者使用，也对新手友好。其社区驱动的模式鼓励创新与持续优化，使Langfuse成为AI技术不断演进领域中的重要资源。

overview.en-US: BigBlueButton is a purpose-built virtual classroom that empowers teachers to teach and learners to learn.
overview.zh-CN: 围绕现实世界的学生、教师和学校设计的虚拟课堂软件

description.en-US:
BigBlueButton is completely open-source and was created by a community of dedicated developers passionate about helping improve online learning. BigBlueButton's focus is singular: support teaching with improved, online tools that allow teachers to connect with students in ways that are synchronized, collaborative and fun.

BigBlueButton can be integrated with LMS such as Moodle, Canvas, and Sakai.
description.zh-CN:
BigBlueButton 是完全开源的，由热衷于帮助改善在线学习的敬业开发人员社区创建。BigBlueButton的愿景是通过改进的在线工具支持教学，使教师能够以同步、协作和有趣的方式与学生联系。

BigBlueButton 能够 Moodle, Canvas, Sakai 等LMS 集成。

en-US: It has been adopted by Canvas, Moodle Cloud, Sakai, Jenzabar, D2L, and Schoology as their default virtual classroom.
zh-CN: 它已被Canvas，Moodle Cloud，Sakai，Jenzabar，D2L和Schoology采用为默认虚拟教室

title.zh-CN: 开源团队密码管理 Bitwarden

summary.zh-CN: 开源团队密码管理

overview.zh-CN: 适用于个人、团队和商业组织的开源密码管理解决方案。

title.en-US: The online home for your community
title.zh-CN: 论坛系统 Discourse

summary.en-US: The online home for your community
summary.zh-CN: 用户社区运营与论坛系统

overview.en-US: Discourse is modern forum software for your community. Use it as a mailing list, discussion forum, long-form chat room, and more. Discourse will not work from an IP address, you must own a domain name such as example.com to proceed.
overview.zh-CN: Discourse 是适用于您社区的现代论坛软件，它必须绑定域名方可使用。

description.en-US:
Discourse is the online home for your community. It offer a 100% open source community platform to those who want complete control over how and where their site is run.

Discourse platform has been battle-tested for over a decade and continues to evolve to meet users’ needs for a powerful community platform. 

Discourse allows you to create discussion topics and connect using real-time chat, as well as access an ever-growing number of official and community themes. In addition, it offer a wide variety of plugins for features ranging from chatbots powered by Discourse AI to functionalities like SQL analysis using the Data Explorer plugin.
description.zh-CN:
Discourse 可以为那些希望完全控制其网站运行方式和位置的人提供 100% 开源社区平台。

它已经经过了十多年的实战考验，并不断发展以满足用户对强大社区平台的需求。Discourse 允许您创建讨论主题并使用实时聊天进行联系，以及访问越来越多的官方和社区主题。

此外，Discourse 还提供了各种各样的插件，其功能范围从由 Discourse AI 提供支持的聊天机器人到使用 Data Explorer 插件的 SQL 分析等功能。

overview.zh-CN: 借助面向 PIM/MDM、DAM、DXP/CMS、CDP 和数字商务的开源数据和体验管理平台，实现最快的上市时间和快速数字化。

title.zh-CN: 开源矢量数据库

summary.zh-CN: 开源矢量数据库

overview.en-US: Weaviate is an open source, vector-based search engine.
overview.zh-CN: Weaviate是一个开源的、基于向量的搜索引擎。

description.en-US: Weaviate is an open source, vector-based search engine designed to handle large-scale, high-dimensional data. It utilizes machine learning and natural language processing techniques to convert data such as text and images into vectors for efficient similarity search.Weaviate supports a wide range of data sources and schemas, including graph databases and time series data. Its modular architecture allows users to customize and extend its functionality for application scenarios such as recommender systems, knowledge graphs, and semantic search, providing high performance and scalability.
description.zh-CN: Weaviate是一个开源的、基于向量的搜索引擎，专为处理大规模、高维度数据设计。它利用机器学习和自然语言处理技术，将文本、图像等数据转换为向量，实现高效的相似性搜索。Weaviate支持多种数据源和模式，包括图数据库和时间序列数据。其模块化架构允许用户自定义和扩展功能，适用于推荐系统、知识图谱、语义搜索等应用场景，提供高性能和可扩展性。

title.zh-CN: 数据迁移，ETL工具

summary.zh-CN: 数据迁移，ETL工具

overview.en-US: Airbyte is an open source data integration platform that supports extracting and loading data from multiple data sources to a target system.
overview.zh-CN: Airbyte 是一个开源数据集成平台，支持从多种数据源提取和加载数据到目标系统。

description.en-US: Airbyte is an open source data integration platform designed to simplify the process of extracting, transforming and loading (ETL) data. It supports multiple data sources and targets including databases, APIs, and data warehouses, allowing users to easily migrate data from one place to another.Airbyte provides a user-friendly interface that allows users to set up data pipelines with simple configuration. Its plug-in architecture enables users to create and share custom connectors to meet specific needs.Airbyte also supports incremental synchronization to ensure real-time data updates for modern data analytics and business intelligence applications.
description.zh-CN: Airbyte 是一个开源的数据集成平台，旨在简化数据的提取、转换和加载（ETL）过程。它支持多种数据源和目标，包括数据库、API 和数据仓库，允许用户轻松地将数据从一个地方迁移到另一个地方。Airbyte 提供了一个用户友好的界面，用户可以通过简单的配置设置数据管道。其插件架构使得用户能够创建和共享自定义连接器，满足特定需求。Airbyte 还支持增量同步，确保数据的实时更新，适合现代数据分析和业务智能应用。

title.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness

summary.zh-CN: AI agent harness framework

overview.en-US: Self-hosted web UI for building, running, and inspecting AI coding agents with pluggable tools and models.

description.en-US:
DeepSeek Harness is an open-source agent harness from DeepSeek AI for building, running, and inspecting AI agents in real-world environments. It provides a browser-based UI, plugin-based runtime composition, session traces, and tooling for models, skills, sandboxes, storage, and workflows.

This Websoft9 package deploys DeepSeek Harness as a single container built from the official Node.js 22 image and the upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh` npm distribution. Persistent state such as sessions and attachments is stored in the `dsh_home` volume, and a dedicated `/workspace` volume is provided as the default working directory for projects opened in the UI.

Typical use cases include evaluating coding agents, experimenting with agent tooling and workflows, creating plugin-based harness presets, and running a self-hosted agent workbench for development teams.

title.zh-CN: 在线学习管理系统 Canvas LMS

summary.en-US: Open-source learning management system for schools, universities, and enterprise training.
summary.zh-CN: 高校在线学习管理系统

overview.en-US:
Canvas is an open-source learning management system (LMS) that provides course management, assignments, grading, quizzes, discussions, and analytics for teachers and learners. This package deploys the official Canvas LMS image with bundled PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.4, giving educational institutions a self-hosted teaching platform.

It is well suited for universities, colleges, K-12 schools, and organizations that want to run their own e-learning platform with full control over data and infrastructure.
overview.zh-CN: 由Websoft9提供的Canvas LMS 镜像，预装了Canvas LMS, PostgreSQL等组件，可一键安装。Canvas 是21世纪的新型LMS，适应当前中国高等教育学习环境。Canvas数据可靠、功能强大、使用方便，我们让每个界面更直观简洁。

description.en-US:
Canvas LMS is an open-source learning management system maintained by Instructure. It is used by thousands of schools and organizations worldwide to deliver online courses, manage assignments and grading, run quizzes and discussions, and track learner progress.

This self-hosted package bundles PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.4 for a single-node deployment. On first startup, an admin account is created from the CANVAS_LMS_ADMIN_EMAIL, CANVAS_LMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and CANVAS_LMS_ACCOUNT_NAME settings.

Typical use cases include course delivery, online exams, institutional e-learning portals, and internal training programs that need a reliable, self-hosted learning platform.
description.zh-CN:
Canvas 是21世纪的新型LMS，适应当前中国高等教育学习环境。Canvas数据可靠、功能强大、使用方便，我们让每个界面更直观简洁，使教学更加容易，为师生最大程度的节约时间。

- 开源、免费，支持多语言（包含中文）
- Canvas数据可靠、功能强大、使用方便，我们让每个界面更直观简洁，使教学更加容易，为师生更大程度的节约时间
- Websoft9对于本镜像提供了Ruby On Rails运行环境，稳定易维护

title.zh-CN: HTTP 服务器 Apache

summary.zh-CN: HTTP 服务器软件

overview.en-US: Apache HTTP Server Project is an effort to develop and maintain an open-source HTTP server
overview.zh-CN: Apache HTTP Server 是一个流行的开源 HTTP 服务器，为应用程序提供 HTTP 服务。

description.en-US: The Apache HTTP Server is an open-source HTTP server project that aims to develop and maintain an HTTP server for modern operating systems, including UNIX and Windows. The goal of the project is to provide a secure, efficient, and extensible server that provides HTTP services in sync with current HTTP standards. It has been the most popular web server on the Internet since April 1996 .
description.zh-CN: Apache HTTP Server 是一个开源的 HTTP 服务器项目，它旨在为现代操作系统（包括 UNIX 和 Windows）开发和维护一个 HTTP 服务器。该项目的目标是提供一个安全、高效、可扩展的服务器，以提供与当前 HTTP 标准同步的 HTTP 服务。

overview.en-US: Apache APISIX is a dynamic, real-time, high-performance cloud-native API gateway that provides rich traffic management features such as load balancing, dynamic upstream, canary releases, service circuit breaking, authentication, and observability.
overview.zh-CN: Apache APISIX provides rich traffic management features like Load Balancing, Dynamic Upstream, Canary Release, Circuit Breaking, Authentication, Observability, etc.

description.en-US: Apache APISIX is based on NGINX and etcd. Compared with traditional API Gateways, APISIX has features like dynamic routing and hot-loading plugins, etc.
description.zh-CN: Apache APISIX is based on NGINX and etcd. Compared with traditional API Gateways, APISIX has features like dynamic routing and hot-loading plugins, etc.

title.zh-CN: 文档型 CMS，支持 Markdown

summary.en-US: BookStack is a simple, self-hosted, easy-to-use platform for organising and storing information.
summary.zh-CN: 文档型 CMS，支持 Markdown

overview.en-US: BookStack is a simple, self-hosted, easy-to-use platform for organising and storing information.
overview.zh-CN: BookStack 是一个简单、自托管、易于使用的信息组织和存储平台。

description.en-US: BookStack is an open source document management and knowledge base platform designed to help users easily create, organize and share documents. It provides an intuitive interface that allows users to organize content through a hierarchy of books, chapters, and pages.BookStack supports the Markdown format, which allows users to edit and format text in a simple way. The platform also features search capabilities, version control, and rights management to ensure document security and accessibility.BookStack is self-hosted, suitable for both team and individual use, and is widely used in scenarios such as project documentation, knowledge bases, and internal wikis.
description.zh-CN: BookStack 是一个开源的文档管理和知识库平台，旨在帮助用户轻松创建、组织和共享文档。它提供了一个直观的界面，用户可以通过书籍、章节和页面的层次结构来组织内容。BookStack 支持Markdown格式，允许用户以简单的方式编辑和格式化文本。该平台还具备搜索功能、版本控制和权限管理，确保文档的安全性和可访问性。BookStack 可以自托管，适合团队和个人使用，广泛应用于项目文档、知识库和内部维基等场景。

title.zh-CN: 无头浏览器与网站自动化工具

summary.zh-CN: 无头浏览器与网站自动化工具

overview.en-US: Browserless is a headless browser service that supports automated web crawling, testing and PDF generation for developers.
overview.zh-CN: Browserless 是一个无头浏览器服务，支持自动化网页抓取、测试和生成 PDF，适用于开发者。

description.en-US: Browserless is a headless browser service designed to simplify web automation and data crawling. It allows developers to run a browser without a GUI, supporting a variety of operations such as web crawling, automated testing, PDF generation and screenshots, etc. Browserless provides API interfaces for easy integration with other applications and supports multiple programming languages. Users can use the software through cloud services or local deployment, which is highly flexible and suitable for developers and organizations that need to process web content efficiently. Its headless mode allows for less resource consumption and faster operation.
description.zh-CN: Browserless 是一个无头浏览器服务，旨在简化网页自动化和数据抓取的过程。它允许开发者在没有图形用户界面的情况下运行浏览器，支持多种操作，如网页抓取、自动化测试、生成 PDF 和截图等。Browserless 提供 API 接口，方便与其他应用集成，支持多种编程语言。用户可以通过云服务或本地部署来使用该软件，灵活性高，适合需要高效处理网页内容的开发者和企业。其无头模式使得资源占用更少，运行速度更快。

title.en-US: Next-Generation Open-Source WAF and Full-Featured Web Server
title.zh-CN: 下一代开源 WAF 和全功能网络服务器

summary.en-US: Next-Generation Open-Source WAF and Full-Featured Web Server
summary.zh-CN: 下一代开源 WAF 和全功能网络服务器

overview.en-US: BunkerWeb is a secure online platform that provides data storage and management services, ensuring the privacy and security of user information.
overview.zh-CN: BunkerWeb 是一个安全的在线平台，提供数据存储和管理服务，以确保用户信息的隐私和安全。

description.en-US:
BunkerWeb is a next-generation and open-source Web Application Firewall (WAF).
Being a full-featured web server (based on NGINX under the hood), it will protect your web services to make them "secure by default". BunkerWeb integrates seamlessly into your existing environments (Linux, Docker, Swarm, Kubernetes, …) and is fully configurable (don't panic, there is an awesome web UI if you don't like the CLI) to meet your own use-cases . In other words, cybersecurity is no more a hassle.
BunkerWeb contains primary security features as part of the core but can be easily extended with additional ones thanks to a plugin system.
description.zh-CN: BunkerWeb是下一代开源Web应用程序防火墙（WAF）。作为一个功能齐全的web服务器（基于底层的NGINX），它将保护您的web服务，使其“默认安全”。BunkerWeb无缝集成到您现有的环境（Linux、Docker、Swarm、Kubernetes等）中，并且是完全可配置的（不要惊慌，如果您不喜欢CLI，有一个很棒的web UI），以满足您自己的用例。换句话说，网络安全不再是一个麻烦。BunkerWeb包含作为核心的主要安全功能，但由于插件系统，可以很容易地扩展其他功能。

title.zh-CN: 数据库 DevOps 工具

summary.zh-CN: 数据库 DevOps 工具

overview.en-US: Bytebase is GitLab/GitHub for Database DevOps, built for developers, DBAs and platform teams.
overview.zh-CN: Bytebase 是面向数据库 DevOps 的 GitLab/GitHub，专为开发人员、DBA 和平台团队打造。

description.en-US:
Bytebase is an open-source database DevOps tool, it's the GitLab/GitHub for managing databases throughout the application development lifecycle. 

Bytebase analyzes SQL changes to enforce rules in compliance with your organization's policy.
description.zh-CN:
Bytebase 是一个开源数据库 DevOps 工具，它是用于在整个应用程序开发生命周期中管理数据库的 GitLab/GitHub。它为 DBA、开发人员和平台工程师提供了一个基于 Web 的协作工作区。

由于 GitLab/GitHub 为团队提供了 GUI 和协作工作区来管理代码，因此 Bytebase 在管理数据库方面也做了类似的工作。

licenseadditional.en-US: https://github.com/bytebase/bytebase/blob/main/LICENSE

title.zh-CN: 网站监控工具

summary.zh-CN: 网站监控工具

overview.en-US: Checkmate is an open-source, self-hosted tool designed to track and monitor server hardware, uptime, response times, and incidents in real-time with beautiful visualizations.
overview.zh-CN: Checkmate是一款网站监控软件，实时跟踪网站性能、可用性和安全性，提供详细报告和警报功能。

description.en-US: Checkmate is an open-source, self-hosted monitoring tool designed to provide real-time tracking and alerts for the availability and performance of websites, APIs, and services. It offers a clean, intuitive interface and supports various monitoring protocols, including HTTP(s), TCP, and DNS, allowing users to configure checks with ease. Checkmate enables customizable notifications via email, Slack, Telegram, and other platforms, ensuring prompt issue detection. With built-in dashboards and historical data visualization, users can analyze uptime trends and pinpoint failures efficiently, enhancing overall system reliability.
description.zh-CN: Checkmate 是一款开源的自托管监控工具，旨在为网站、API 和服务的可用性和性能提供实时跟踪和警报。它拥有简洁直观的界面，并支持包括 HTTP(s)、TCP 和 DNS 在内的多种监控协议，使用户能够轻松配置检查。Checkmate 支持通过电子邮件、Slack、Telegram 等平台自定义通知，确保及时发现故障。内置的仪表板和历史数据可视化功能让用户能够高效分析正常运行时间趋势并快速定位故障，从而提高整体系统可靠性。

title.zh-CN: 开源病毒扫描与检测 ClamAV

summary.zh-CN: 开源病毒扫描与检测

overview.en-US: ClamAV is an open-source antivirus engine for detecting trojans, viruses, malware & other malicious threats.
overview.zh-CN: ClamAV是一个开源的防病毒引擎，用于检测木马，病毒，恶意软件和其他 恶意威胁。

description.en-US: ClamAV is an open source (GPLv2) anti-virus toolkit, designed especially for e-mail scanning on mail gateways. It provides a number of utilities including a flexible and scalable multi-threaded daemon, a command line scanner and advanced tool for automatic database updates. The core of the package is an anti-virus engine available in a form of shared library.
description.zh-CN: ClamAV 是一个开源 （GPLv2） 防病毒工具包，专为邮件网关上的电子邮件扫描而设计。它提供了许多实用程序，包括灵活且可扩展的多线程守护程序、命令行扫描程序和用于自动数据库更新的高级工具。该软件包的核心是以共享库的形式提供的防病毒引擎。

en-US: ClamAV is brought to you by Cisco Systems, Inc.
ClamAV detects millions of viruses, worms, trojans, and other malware, including Microsoft Office macro viruses, mobile malware, and other threats.
zh-CN: ClamAV is brought to you by Cisco Systems, Inc.
ClamAV 可检测数百万种病毒、蠕虫、特洛伊木马和其他恶意软件，包括 Microsoft Office 宏病毒、移动恶意软件和其他威胁

title.zh-CN: 轻量级订阅阅读器

summary.zh-CN: 轻量级订阅阅读器

overview.en-US: CommaFeed is an open source RSS reader with a simple interface that supports self-hosted and online use, making it easy to manage feeds.
overview.zh-CN: CommaFeed 是一个开源的 RSS 阅读器，界面简洁，支持自托管和在线使用，方便管理订阅源

description.en-US: CommaFeed is an open source RSS reader designed to provide a clean and efficient user experience. It supports self-hosting, which allows users to run it on their own servers to ensure data privacy and security.CommaFeed provides an intuitive interface for users to manage and browse subscribed RSS feeds. Users can easily add, delete and categorize subscriptions, and it supports offline reading and full-text extraction. In addition, CommaFeed supports a variety of themes and customization options to meet the needs of different users. Whether for personal use or teamwork, CommaFeed is an ideal choice for those who like minimalist design and efficient reading.
description.zh-CN: CommaFeed 是一个开源的 RSS 阅读器，旨在提供简洁而高效的用户体验。它支持自托管，用户可以在自己的服务器上运行，确保数据的隐私和安全。CommaFeed 提供了直观的界面，方便用户管理和浏览订阅的 RSS 源。用户可以轻松添加、删除和分类订阅，支持离线阅读和全文提取功能。此外，CommaFeed 还支持多种主题和自定义选项，满足不同用户的需求。无论是个人使用还是团队协作，CommaFeed 都是一个理想的选择，适合喜欢简约设计和高效阅读的用户。

title.zh-CN: 开源人脸识别系统

summary.zh-CN: 开源人脸识别系统

overview.en-US: CompreFace is an open source face recognition software that provides an easy-to-use API and supports a wide range of face recognition features.
overview.zh-CN: CompreFace 是一款开源人脸识别软件，提供简单易用的 API，支持多种人脸识别功能。

description.en-US:
CompreFace is an open source face recognition software designed to provide developers and enterprises with powerful face recognition capabilities. It makes integrating face recognition capabilities easier with an easy-to-use API.CompreFace supports a wide range of features, including face detection, recognition, comparison and attribute analysis, and is capable of handling large amounts of image data.

The software is highly customizable, allowing users to train their own models on demand to improve recognition accuracy. In addition, CompreFace provides a user-friendly interface that makes it easy for users to manage and monitor the recognition process. It is suitable for a variety of scenarios such as security monitoring, user authentication and personalized services, making it ideal for building intelligent applications.
description.zh-CN:
CompreFace 是一款开源的人脸识别软件，旨在为开发者和企业提供强大的人脸识别功能。它通过简单易用的 API，使得集成人脸识别能力变得更加便捷。CompreFace 支持多种功能，包括人脸检测、识别、对比和属性分析，能够处理大量图像数据。

该软件具有高度的可定制性，用户可以根据需求训练自己的模型，以提高识别准确性。此外，CompreFace 提供了友好的用户界面，方便用户管理和监控识别过程。它适用于安全监控、用户身份验证和个性化服务等多种场景，是构建智能应用的理想选择。

title.zh-CN: DNS 和服务发现

summary.zh-CN: DNS 和服务发现

overview.en-US: CoreDNS is a flexible DNS server that supports a plug-in architecture and is widely used in Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.
overview.zh-CN: CoreDNS 是一个灵活的 DNS 服务器，支持插件架构，广泛用于 Kubernetes 和云原生环境。

description.en-US: CoreDNS is a flexible and scalable DNS server designed for cloud-native environments. It uses a plug-in architecture that allows users to customize functionality based on their needs, and supports a wide range of DNS protocols and services.CoreDNS can be used as the default DNS solution for Kubernetes, providing service discovery and load balancing capabilities. It is simple to configure, uses easy-to-understand configuration files, and supports a variety of back-end data sources such as etcd, Kubernetes APIs, and files. coreDNS is also high-performance and scalable, suitable for handling large-scale DNS queries, and is widely used in modern microservice architectures and containerized environments.
description.zh-CN: CoreDNS 是一个灵活且可扩展的 DNS 服务器，专为云原生环境设计。它采用插件架构，允许用户根据需求定制功能，支持多种 DNS 协议和服务。CoreDNS 可以作为 Kubernetes 的默认 DNS 解决方案，提供服务发现和负载均衡功能。其配置简单，使用易于理解的配置文件，支持多种后端数据源，如 etcd、Kubernetes API 和文件。CoreDNS 还具备高性能和可扩展性，适合处理大规模的 DNS 查询，广泛应用于现代微服务架构和容器化环境中。

overview.zh-CN: Countly 是可用于本地移动和 Web 应用程序分析的平台，具有更多功能、更直观的 UI、完整的 API 支持和原始数据访问

title.zh-CN: AI 代理开发工具

It offers a low-code or even no-code visual interface to rapidly build, debug, and deploy large language model–powered applications. With built-in plugins, knowledge base management, multi-turn conversation design, and automated workflows, Coze supports multimodal capabilities including text and images. Users can easily create AI-powered solutions such as customer service bots, content generation assistants, and enterprise knowledge Q&A systems, and deploy them instantly to websites, mini-programs, social media, and more—significantly lowering the barrier to AI application development and accelerating innovation.
description.zh-CN: Coze 是一款面向开发者与非技术用户的智能 AI 应用开发平台，提供低代码甚至无代码的可视化操作界面，支持快速构建、调试和部署基于大语言模型的智能应用。平台内置丰富的插件生态、知识库管理、多轮对话设计及自动化工作流，兼容文本、图像等多模态能力。用户可轻松创建智能客服、内容创作助手、企业知识问答系统等应用，并一键发布至 Web、小程序、社交媒体等渠道，极大降低 AI 应用开发门槛，提升创新效率

title.zh-CN: 开源 WAF

summary.zh-CN: 开源 WAF

overview.en-US: CrowdSec is open source cybersecurity software that provides real-time protection and scalability through community collaboration to detect and defend against malicious behavior.
overview.zh-CN: CrowdSec 是开源网络安全软件，通过社区合作检测和防御恶意行为，提供实时保护和可扩展性。

description.en-US: CrowdSec is an open source network security protection software designed to improve network security through community collaboration. It analyzes server logs and traffic to detect and defend against malicious behavior, such as brute force and DDoS attacks, in real time.CrowdSec is unique in that it is community-driven, allowing users to share attack information and protection rules to continuously optimize detection capabilities. The software supports a wide range of protection measures, including IP blocking and traffic restriction, providing flexibility to address different types of threats. In addition, CrowdSec integrates easily with existing systems and can be used in a variety of environments, helping users to effectively reduce security risks and improve overall protection.
description.zh-CN: CrowdSec 是一款开源网络安全防护软件，旨在通过社区合作提升网络安全性。它通过分析服务器日志和流量，实时检测和防御恶意行为，如暴力破解和DDoS攻击。CrowdSec 的独特之处在于其社区驱动的特性，用户可以共享攻击信息和防护规则，从而不断优化检测能力。软件支持多种防护措施，包括 IP 封禁和流量限制，能够灵活应对不同类型的威胁。此外，CrowdSec 易于与现有系统集成，适用于各种环境，帮助用户有效降低安全风险，提升整体防护水平。

description.zh-CN:
它充满了有用的功能，可以帮助您构建完美的仪表板。包括状态检查、键盘快捷键、动态小部件、自动获取的favicon图标和字体支持、内置身份验证、大量主题、交互式配置编辑器、许多显示布局以及加载更多内容。
所有代码都是免费和开源的，所有内容都有完整的文档记录，您可以在GitHub上获得任何问题的支持。

title.zh-CN: 数据库备份工具

summary.zh-CN: 数据库备份工具

overview.en-US: Databasus is an open-source performance monitoring and visualization platform for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB databases.
overview.zh-CN: Databasus 是一个针对 MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB 数据库的开源性能监控与可视化平台。

description.en-US:
Databasus is a free, open-source, self-hosted database backup solution. Its core functionality is to provide reliable, automated backups for mainstream databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB. 
Its strength lies in flexible storage and notification integration. You can securely store backup files in various target locations, including local disks, S3-compatible object storage, Google Drive, or FTP servers. Additionally, it supports sending real-time backup progress notifications via popular communication platforms such as Slack, Discord, and Telegram, allowing administrators to stay updated on task status at all times. 
By integrating multi-database support, cloud storage, and instant alerts into a single tool, Databasus aims to provide developers and operations teams with a modern, unified data protection solution.
description.zh-CN:
Databasus 是一款免费、开源、可自托管的数据库备份解决方案。它的核心功能是为 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB 和 MongoDB 等主流数据库提供可靠、自动化的备份。
其强大之处在于灵活的存储和通知集成。您可以将备份文件安全存储在各种目标位置，包括本地磁盘、S3 兼容对象存储、Google Drive 或 FTP 服务器。同时，它支持通过 Slack、Discord、Telegram 等流行通讯平台发送实时备份进度通知，让管理员随时掌握任务状态。
通过将多数据库支持、云存储集成和即时告警结合在一个工具中，Databasus 旨在为开发者与运维团队提供一个现代化、一体化的数据保护工具。

title.en-US: Simple and easy to use DDNS
title.zh-CN: 开源的动态 DNS 服务

summary.en-US: Simple and easy to use DDNS
summary.zh-CN: 开源的动态 DNS 服务

overview.en-US: ddns-go automatically obtain your public IPv4 or IPv6 address and resolve it to the corresponding domain name service.
overview.zh-CN: ddns-go 自动获得你的公网 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址，并解析到对应的域名服务。

description.en-US: ddns-go is an open source Dynamic DNS (DDNS) service  serdesigned to simplify the mapping between domain names and dynamic IP addresses. It supports a wide range of DNS service providers and allows users to automatically update their domain name records when an IP address changes. ddns-go ensures that a domain name always points to the correct IP address by periodically checking for changes in the local IP address and sending an update request to the specified DNS service when a change is detected. Suitable for home users and small businesses, the tool provides simple configuration options and flexible usage for managing domain name resolution in dynamic IP environments.
description.zh-CN: ddns-go 是一个开源的动态 DNS（DDNS）服务，旨在简化域名与动态 IP 地址之间的映射。它支持多种 DNS 服务提供商，允许用户在 IP 地址变化时自动更新其域名记录。ddns-go 通过定期检查本地 IP 地址的变化，并在检测到变化时向指定的 DNS 服务发送更新请求，从而确保域名始终指向正确的 IP 地址。该工具适用于家庭用户和小型企业，提供了简单的配置选项和灵活的使用方式，方便用户管理动态 IP 环境中的域名解析。

title.zh-CN: 开源分布式平台

summary.en-US: an open source distributed platform for change data capture
summary.zh-CN: 一个用于变更数据捕获的开源分布式平台

overview.en-US: Debezium is an open-source tool that captures database change streams, enabling low-latency data change event streams to facilitate real-time data synchronization.
overview.zh-CN: Debezium是一款开源工具，通过捕获数据库变更流，实现低延迟的数据变更事件流，助力实时数据同步。

description.en-US: Debezium is an open-source, distributed CDC (Change Data Capture) platform. It reads database logs and converts row-level data changes (such as inserts, updates, deletes) into real-time event streams with very low latency, then streams them to message brokers like Kafka. This enables microservices to reliably capture real-time database state changes, facilitating data synchronization across heterogeneous systems, cache updates, and streaming analytics.
description.zh-CN: Debezium 是一款开源的分布式 变更数据捕获平台。它通过读取数据库日志，以极低的延迟将行级别的数据变更（如插入、更新、删除）转化为实时事件流，并发送到 Kafka 等消息队列。这使得微服务能够可靠地获取数据库的实时状态变更，从而实现异构系统数据同步、缓存更新和流式分析。

title.zh-CN: 图数据库 Dgraph

summary.zh-CN: 高性能的 NoSQL 图数据库

overview.en-US: Built to be fault-tolerant, on a distributed graph database, that gives developers the tools to rapidly build and model applications at scale
overview.zh-CN: 在分布式图形数据库上构建为容错能力，为开发人员提供了快速构建和大规模建模应用程序的工具

description.en-US: Dgraph is a horizontally scalable and distributed GraphQL database with a graph backend. It provides ACID transactions, consistent replication, and linearizable reads. It's built from the ground up to perform a rich set of queries. Being a native GraphQL database, it tightly controls how the data is arranged on disk to optimize for query performance and throughput, reducing disk seeks and network calls in a cluster.
description.zh-CN: Dgraph是一个具有图形后端的水平可扩展和分布式GraphQL数据库。它提供ACID事务、一致复制和线性化读取。它从头开始构建，可以执行一组丰富的查询。作为原生GraphQL数据库，它严格控制数据在磁盘上的排列方式，以优化查询性能和吞吐量，减少集群中的磁盘寻道和网络调用。

title.en-US: Production-ready fullstack but simple mail server
title.zh-CN: 邮件服务器

summary.en-US: Production-ready fullstack but simple mail server
summary.zh-CN: 邮件服务器

overview.en-US: docker-mailserver, or DMS for short, is a production-ready fullstack but simple mail server (SMTP, IMAP, LDAP, Anti-spam, Anti-virus, etc.). It employs only configuration files, no SQL database. The image is focused around the slogan "Keep it simple and versioned".
overview.zh-CN: Docker 邮件服务器，简称 DMS，是一款可投入生产的全栈式但简单的邮件服务器（支持 SMTP、IMAP、LDAP 协议，具备反垃圾邮件、防病毒等功能）。它仅使用配置文件，无需 SQL 数据库。该镜像围绕 “保持简洁且有版本控制” 这一口号打造

description.en-US: A mail server operates within a client-server framework to manage email exchange. While clients (e.g., Mutt, Thunderbird, web interfaces) typically use a single program for email retrieval and viewing, the server side relies on multiple specialized components (agents) to handle tasks like acceptance, forwarding, delivery, and storage of messages. DMS (Docker Mail Server) simplifies this complexity by integrating and pre-configuring these server-side agents, providing a ready-to-use platform for deploying a fully functional mail server efficiently. It handles critical operations seamlessly, enabling users to focus on email management without needing deep expertise in server setup or protocol configuration.
description.zh-CN: 邮件服务器基于客户端 - 服务器架构管理邮件交换，服务器端依赖多组件处理接收、转发、存储等任务。Docker 邮件服务器（DMS）集成预配置这些组件，简化部署复杂度，提供即用平台，让用户专注邮件管理，无需精通服务器配置与协议细节。

description.en-US: Doris is a high-performance open-source analytical database designed for real-time data analysis and Online Analytical Processing (OLAP). It features horizontal scalability, supports fast queries and high-concurrency access, making it an ideal choice for big data scenarios. Doris offers a simple SQL query language, accommodates various data formats and ETL capabilities, and integrates seamlessly with other big data platforms. Users can manage it through a user-friendly interface and APIs, making it suitable for data warehousing, business intelligence, and real-time data analysis applications.

title.en-US: Free backup software to store encrypted backups online

description.en-US:
EMQX supports up to 100 million concurrent IoT device connections per cluster while maintaining a throughput of 1 million messages per second and a sub-millisecond latency.

EMQX supports various protocols, including MQTT (3.1, 3.1.1, and 5.0), HTTP, QUIC, and WebSocket. It also provides secure bi-directional communication with MQTT over TLS/SSL and various authentication mechanisms, ensuring reliable and efficient communication infrastructure for IoT devices and applications.

EMQX支持每个集群多达 1 亿个并发 IoT 设备连接，同时保持每秒 100 万条消息的吞吐量和亚毫秒级延迟。

EMQX 支持多种协议，包括 MQTT（3.1、3.1.1 和 5.0）、HTTP、QUIC 和 WebSocket。它还通过 TLS/SSL 和 MQTT 以及各种身份验证机制提供安全的双向通信，确保物联网设备和应用程序的可靠和高效的通信基础设施。

overview.en-US: Headscale is an open source, self-hosted Tailscale control server for building WireGuard-based peer-to-peer (P2P) virtual private networks (VPNs).
overview.zh-CN: ​Headscale​​ 是一款开源的、自托管的​​Tailscale控制服务器​​，用于构建基于WireGuard的点对点（P2P）虚拟专用网络（VPN）。

description.en-US: Headscale is an open source, self-hosted Tailscale control server for building WireGuard-based peer-to-peer (P2P) virtual private networks (VPNs). It serves as an open source alternative to Tailscale, allowing users to take full control of their private network infrastructure, freeing them from dependence on official Tailscale cloud services. With Headscale, users can establish encrypted, directly connected communications across devices (e.g., servers, PCs, mobile), supporting intranet penetration, low-latency transmission and cross-platform compatibility (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.). Its core features include device authentication (based on OAuth/SSO), access control lists (ACLs), and network status monitoring, making it suitable for enterprise intranets, remote offices, IoT device management, and other scenarios. The open source nature makes it highly customizable and suitable for privacy and security focused teams.
description.zh-CN: ​Headscale​​ 是一款开源的、自托管的​​Tailscale控制服务器​​，用于构建基于WireGuard的点对点（P2P）虚拟专用网络（VPN）。它作为Tailscale的开源替代方案，允许用户完全掌控私有网络基础设施，摆脱对Tailscale官方云服务的依赖。通过Headscale，用户可跨设备（如服务器、PC、移动端）建立加密的直连通信，支持内网穿透、低延迟传输和跨平台兼容性（Linux、Windows、macOS等）。其核心功能包括设备认证（基于OAuth/SSO）、访问控制列表（ACL）和网络状态监控，适用于企业内网、远程办公、IoT设备管理等场景。开源特性使其可定制性强，适合注重隐私与安全的团队。

description.en-US: The open source AIOps and Alert Management Platform is an integrated solution designed to improve the efficiency of IT operations through artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. The platform monitors system performance in real-time, automatically analyzes logs and events, identifies potential problems and generates intelligent alerts. With centralized management and visual dashboards, users can quickly understand system status and reduce downtime for recovery. The platform supports customized alert rules to ensure that teams can respond to critical events in a timely manner. In addition, the open source nature allows users to customize and extend it according to their needs, promoting community collaboration and innovation. Overall, the platform helps organizations achieve greater operational efficiency and a better user experience.
description.zh-CN: 开源 AIOps 和警报管理平台是一种集成的解决方案，旨在通过人工智能和机器学习技术提升 IT 运维效率。该平台能够实时监控系统性能，自动分析日志和事件，识别潜在问题并生成智能警报。通过集中管理和可视化仪表板，用户可以快速了解系统状态，减少故障恢复时间。平台支持自定义警报规则，确保团队能够及时响应关键事件。此外，开源特性使得用户可以根据自身需求进行定制和扩展，促进社区协作与创新。整体而言，这种平台帮助企业实现更高的运营效率和更好的用户体验。

overview.en-US: Kavita is a fast, feature rich, cross platform reading server. Built with the goal of being a full solution for all your reading needs. Setup your own server and share your reading collection with your friends and family.
overview.zh-CN: Kavita是一个快速、功能丰富、跨平台的阅读服务器。旨在为您的所有阅读需求提供完整的解决方案。设置自己的服务器，并与朋友和家人分享您的阅读收藏。

description.en-US: Kavita is a feature rich open-source media manager that focuses on organizing and reading comics, light novels, and e-books. It supports multiple file formats, including ZIP, RAR, EPUB, and PDF, and provides built-in image, EPUB, and PDF readers. Users can customize their reading experience, such as fonts, spacing, themes, and more. Kavita has a full-text search function, which can quickly find files, bookmarks, reading lists, etc. It also supports metadata filtering, rating, and commenting functions, making it convenient for users to manage and discover content. It also allows users to create and manage accounts, share library resources, and provide cross platform support without relying on external programs, responding quickly and suitable for comic book enthusiasts and e-book readers.
description.zh-CN: Kavita 是一款功能丰富的开源媒体管理器，专注于漫画、轻小说和电子书的整理与阅读。它支持多种文件格式，包括 ZIP、RAR、EPUB 和 PDF 等，提供内置的图像、EPUB 和 PDF 阅读器，用户可自定义阅读体验，如字体、间距、主题等。Kavita 具备全文搜索功能，可快速查找文件、书签、阅读列表等，还支持元数据过滤、评分和评论功能，方便用户管理和发现内容。它还允许用户创建和管理账户，共享图书馆资源，并提供跨平台支持，无需依赖外部程序，响应迅速，适合漫画爱好者和电子书读者使用。

overview.en-US: Listmonk is a self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager that supports efficient email marketing and subscriber management.
overview.zh-CN: Listmonk 是一个自托管的通讯和邮件列表管理器，支持高效的邮件营销和用户管理。

description.en-US:
listmonk is a Self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager.It has the following features:

- Manage millions of subscribers across many single and double opt-in one-way mailing lists with custom JSON attributes for each subscriber. Query and segment subscribers with SQL expressions.

- Simple analytics and visualizations. Connect external visualization programs to the database easily with the simple table structure.

description.zh-CN:
listmonk是一款自托管的新闻通讯和邮件列表管理器，具有以下功能：

- 管理多个单向和双向选择邮件列表中的数百万订阅者，并为每个订阅者自定义 JSON 属性。使用 SQL 表达式查询和细分订阅者。

- 多线程、高吞吐量、多 SMTP 电子邮件队列。吞吐量和滑动窗口速率限制可实现精细控制。

description.en-US: Linkwarden is an open-source collaborative bookmark management tool designed to help users efficiently collect, organize, and archive web links. It supports collecting web pages and bookmarks from any browser, and organizing links through collections, subsets, and tags. Linkwarden has powerful webpage archiving capabilities, which can automatically save screenshots and PDF copies of webpages. Even if the webpage is taken down, it can still be accessed, effectively preventing link corruption. In addition, it supports collaboration functionality, where users can collaborate to collect resources in a collection and assign customizable permissions to each member, making it easy to share curated collections. As a self hosted solution, Linkwarden guarantees the privacy of user data and will not sell it to third parties. It also offers responsive design, supports multiple screen sizes, and powerful search functionality, making it easy for users to find and manage their favorite content.
description.zh-CN: Linkwarden 是一款开源的协作式书签管理工具，旨在帮助用户高效地收集、整理和存档网页链接。它支持从任何浏览器收集网页和书签，并通过集合、子集合和标签来组织链接。Linkwarden 具备强大的网页存档功能，可以自动保存网页的截图和 PDF 副本，即使网页被撤下也能访问，有效防止链接腐烂。此外，它支持协作功能，用户可以在集合中协作收集资源，并为每个成员分配可定制的权限，轻松共享精选集合。作为一款自托管的解决方案，Linkwarden 保障用户数据的隐私，不会将数据出售给第三方。它还提供了响应式设计，支持多种屏幕尺寸，以及强大的搜索功能，方便用户查找和管理收藏的内容。

overview.en-US: ModSecurity is an open-source web application firewall that provides real-time monitoring, attack detection, and protection capabilities to enhance web security.
overview.zh-CN: ModSecurity是一个开源Web应用防火墙，提供实时监控、攻击检测和防护功能，增强Web安全性。

description.en-US: ModSecurity is an open-source Web Application Firewall (WAF) designed to protect web applications from various cyberattacks. By continuously monitoring and analyzing HTTP requests and responses in real-time, it detects and blocks common attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). ModSecurity supports flexible rule sets, allowing users to customize rules according to specific security policies. It integrates with multiple web servers including Apache, Nginx, and IIS to provide comprehensive security protection. Additionally, ModSecurity supports logging and auditing features, helping administrators monitor and analyze potential security threats.
description.zh-CN: ModSecurity是一个开源Web应用防火墙（WAF），旨在保护Web应用程序免受各种网络攻击。它通过实时监控和分析HTTP请求和响应，能够检测和阻止SQL注入、跨站脚本（XSS）等常见攻击。ModSecurity支持灵活的规则集，用户可以根据需求自定义规则，以适应特定的安全策略。它可以与Apache、Nginx和IIS等多种Web服务器集成，提供全面的安全防护。此外，ModSecurity还支持日志记录和审计功能，帮助管理员监控和分析潜在的安全威胁。

description.en-US:
Optimized for readability
The page layout, fonts, and colors are chosen to enhance readability on a screen. The content is the most important thing. Everything else is just noise.
Download original article contents
Do you have feeds that display only a summary? Automatically fetch the original article.
No fancy features
Do you dislike bloated software? Miniflux focuses on simplicity. Less is more!
Fast and efficient
Be productive by using keyboard shortcuts to navigate through the application. Quickly scan your unread items with the lightweight user interface.
Your privacy is guaranteed
Miniflux automatically removes pixel trackers, eliminates tracking parameters from URLs, uses a media proxy to prevent third-party tracking, and does not forward any referrer. There is absolutely no telemetry or advertising.
Super simple installation
Miniflux is compiled statically without external dependencies. Drop the binary on your server, and you're done. You can also use the RPM/Debian package or the Docker image.
Free, open source, and self-hosted
Miniflux is a free and open-source project distributed under the permissive Apache 2.0 License.

优化可读性
页面布局、字体和颜色的选择是为了提高在屏幕上的可读性。内容是最重要的。其他一切都只是噪音。
下载原始文章内容
您的新闻源只显示摘要吗？自动获取原始文章。
没有花哨的功能
您不喜欢臃肿的软件吗？Miniflux 注重简洁。少即是多！
快速高效
使用键盘快捷键浏览应用程序，提高工作效率。使用轻量级用户界面快速扫描未读条目。
保证您的隐私
Miniflux 会自动移除像素跟踪器，消除 URL 中的跟踪参数，使用媒体代理防止第三方跟踪，并且不会转发任何推荐人。绝对没有遥测或广告。
安装超级简单
Miniflux 是静态编译的，没有外部依赖性。将二进制文件放到服务器上，即可完成安装。您也可以使用 RPM/Debian 软件包或 Docker 镜像。
免费、开源和自托管
Miniflux 是一个免费的开源项目，采用 Apache 2.0 许可发布。

description.en-US:
TimescaleDB is an open-source time-series database built as a PostgreSQL extension. It keeps full PostgreSQL compatibility while adding hypertables, compression, continuous aggregates, retention policies, and other features for high-ingest time-series workloads and real-time analytics.

This package deploys the official TimescaleDB HA image on PostgreSQL 18, publishes the PostgreSQL port, and persists database data in a named volume. The default `postgres` account is package-managed, and the bundled health and validation checks verify that the TimescaleDB extension is available after startup.

Typical use cases include IoT telemetry, observability, financial events, industrial metrics, and any workload that needs SQL analytics on fast-growing time-series data.

title.zh-CN: pgvector

summary.zh-CN: PostgreSQL 向量数据库

overview.en-US: pgvector adds vector similarity search to PostgreSQL, letting embeddings be stored and queried alongside relational data.

description.en-US:
pgvector is an open-source extension that brings vector similarity search to PostgreSQL. It adds a vector data type plus indexing and distance operators, enabling exact and approximate nearest neighbor search directly in SQL.

This package deploys the official pgvector/pgvector image, which is built on PostgreSQL 18 (Debian trixie) and ships the pgvector extension. On first startup an init script enables the vector extension in the default database, so it can be used immediately. The image tag is pinned to pg18-trixie.

Typical use cases include semantic search, recommendation systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for AI applications, image and text similarity, and any workload that needs vector search next to relational data.

title.zh-CN: Postgres 数据库 API 转换中间件

summary.zh-CN: Postgres 数据库 API 转换中间件

overview.en-US: PostgREST is a standalone web server that turns your PostgreSQL database directly into a RESTful API. The structural constraints and permissions in the database determine the API endpoints and operations.
overview.zh-CN: PostgREST 是一个独立的 Web 服务器，可将您的 PostgreSQL 数据库直接转换为 RESTful API。数据库中的结构约束和权限决定了 API 端点和操作。

description.en-US: PostgREST is an open-source tool that turns your PostgreSQL database directly into a RESTful API. The basic idea is that rather than writing backend code to interact with your database, you can simply configure PostgREST and it will provide a web API interface automatically, based on the structure of your database.
description.zh-CN: PostgREST 是一种开源工具，可以将您的 PostgreSQL 数据库直接转换为 RESTful API。其基本思想是，您无需编写与数据库交互的后端代码，只需配置 PostgREST，它就会根据数据库的结构自动提供 Web API 接口。

overview.en-US: Qdrant stores embeddings and payloads for vector search, hybrid retrieval, and semantic AI applications.

description.en-US:
Qdrant is an open-source vector database and similarity search engine designed for production AI workloads. It stores embeddings with JSON payloads, exposes REST and gRPC APIs, and supports filtering, hybrid search, quantization, multitenancy, snapshots, and a built-in web UI.

This package deploys the official single-node Qdrant server, publishes both the REST and gRPC ports, and persists vector storage in a named volume. The default deployment keeps authentication disabled to match the upstream quickstart, so operators should enable API keys before exposing it to untrusted networks.

Typical use cases include RAG systems, semantic search, recommendation engines, multimodal retrieval, and other applications that need fast vector indexing and nearest-neighbor search.

title.zh-CN: 开源可观测性平台

summary.zh-CN: 开源可观测性平台

overview.en-US: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform native to OpenTelemetry with logs, traces and metrics in a single application.
overview.zh-CN: SigNoz 是一个基于 OpenTelemetry 的开源可观测性平台，支持日志、跟踪和指标的统一管理，所有功能集成于单一应用程序中。

description.en-US: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform based on OpenTelemetry, integrating three core functionalities: metrics, tracing, and logging, to provide a comprehensive monitoring solution. As a CNCF project, it natively supports the OpenTelemetry standard, enabling easy collection, storage, and analysis of application performance data. SigNoz offers pre-built dashboards, distributed tracing, log correlation, and intelligent alerts to help developers quickly identify performance bottlenecks and issues in microservice architectures. Its low-code UI and cloud-native architecture significantly reduce deployment complexity, supporting environments such as Kubernetes and Docker. The core code is licensed under Apache 2.0/MIT, making it suitable as an alternative to commercial tools (such as DataDog) to achieve low-cost, high-performance end-to-end monitoring.
description.zh-CN: SigNoz 是一个基于 OpenTelemetry 的开源可观测性平台，整合了三大核心功能：指标、追踪和日志，为用户提供全面的监控解决方案。作为 CNCF 项目，它原生支持 OpenTelemetry 标准，可轻松实现应用性能数据的采集、存储与分析。SigNoz 提供预构建的仪表盘、分布式追踪、日志关联和智能警报，帮助开发人员快速识别微服务架构中的性能瓶颈和问题。其低代码 UI 和云原生架构显著降低了部署复杂性，支持 Kubernetes 和 Docker 等环境。核心代码采用 Apache 2.0/MIT 许可证，使其可作为商业工具（如 DataDog）的替代方案，实现低成本、高性能的端到端监控。

A. HISTORY OF THE SOFTWARE
==========================

Python was created in the early 1990s by Guido van Rossum at Stichting
Mathematisch Centrum (CWI, see https://www.cwi.nl) in the Netherlands
as a successor of a language called ABC.  Guido remains Python's
principal author, although it includes many contributions from others.

In 1995, Guido continued his work on Python at the Corporation for
National Research Initiatives (CNRI, see https://www.cnri.reston.va.us)
in Reston, Virginia where he released several versions of the
software.

In May 2000, Guido and the Python core development team moved to
BeOpen.com to form the BeOpen PythonLabs team.  In October of the same
year, the PythonLabs team moved to Digital Creations, which became
Zope Corporation.  In 2001, the Python Software Foundation (PSF, see
https://www.python.org/psf/) was formed, a non-profit organization
created specifically to own Python-related Intellectual Property.
Zope Corporation was a sponsoring member of the PSF.

All Python releases are Open Source (see https://opensource.org for
the Open Source Definition).  Historically, most, but not all, Python
releases have also been GPL-compatible; the table below summarizes
the various releases.

    Release         Derived     Year        Owner       GPL-

With capabilities in product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, and experiments, PostHog provides the tools needed to understand user behavior, optimize user experience, and drive product growth. It's the perfect solution for developers looking to make data-driven decisions and iterate quickly.

Description

description.en-US: PostHog is a powerful product analytics platform that offers a wide range of features to help you build successful products. With PostHog, you can analyze user behavior through funnels, graphs, and user paths, and gain insights into product stickiness, lifecycle, retention, and more. The platform also includes session replay for watching user interactions, feature flags for safely rolling out new features, and experiments to test different variations. Additionally, PostHog provides surveys for collecting in-app feedback and data pipelines for building your customer data platform. Join the community of developers using PostHog to make data-driven decisions and accelerate product development.
description.zh-CN: PostHog是一个功能强大的产品分析平台，提供广泛的功能帮助您构建成功的产品。使用PostHog，您可以通过漏斗、图表和用户路径分析用户行为，并获得关于产品粘性、生命周期、留存等的洞察。平台还包括会话回放以观看用户交互，特性旗帜用于安全推出新特性，以及实验以测试不同变体。此外，PostHog提供调查以收集应用内反馈和数据管道以构建您的客户数据平台。加入使用PostHog的开发者社区，做出数据驱动的决策，加速产品开发。

title.zh-CN: 组织团队聊天

overview.en-US: open-source team chat with topic-based threading for organization.
overview.zh-CN: Zulip 是一个开源团队聊天工具，支持话题化讨论。

description.en-US: Zulip is an open-source team chat application that combines the immediacy of real-time chat with an email-like threading model. This unique approach allows users to organize conversations by topics within channels, making it easier to follow discussions and stay on top of important messages. Zulip supports integrations with numerous tools, enabling seamless workflows and enhanced productivity. It is available on multiple platforms, including web, desktop, and mobile, ensuring accessibility for all team members. With features like advanced search, message pinning, and customizable notifications, Zulip is designed to facilitate efficient and organized team communication.
description.zh-CN: Zulip 是一款开源团队聊天应用程序，它将实时聊天的即时性与类似电子邮件的线程模式相结合。这种独特的方法允许用户在频道内按主题组织会话，从而更容易跟踪讨论并掌握重要信息。Zulip 支持与多种工具集成，实现了无缝工作流并提高了工作效率。它可在网页、桌面和移动等多个平台上使用，确保所有团队成员都能使用。Zulip 具有高级搜索、消息固定和自定义通知等功能，旨在促进高效、有序的团队沟通。

summary.en-US: Open-source AI search and vector database.

overview.en-US: Vespa is an open-source search engine and vector database for AI, serving low-latency search and ranking at scale.

description.en-US:
Vespa is an open-source, distributed compute engine for search and AI. It combines vector search, text search, and structured filtering with machine-learned ranking, and serves low-latency queries over large datasets.

This package deploys the official vespaengine/vespa image as a single container running both the config server and the services role. The config server / deployment API is published on port 19071, and the query and document HTTP API on port 8080. Application data and logs are persisted in named volumes mounted at /opt/vespa/var and /opt/vespa/logs. Vespa starts serving the HTTP API on port 8080 only after an application package is deployed to the config server.

Typical use cases include vector and hybrid search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for AI applications, recommendation and ranking systems, and large-scale document search.

description.en-US: Vaultwarden is an open source, lightweight password management solution based on Bitwarden's API implementation. It provides a self-hosted server environment that allows users to securely store and manage passwords, credit card information, identities, and security notes.Vaultwarden is known for its low resource footprint and ease of deployment, making it suitable for running on resource-constrained devices such as the Raspberry Pi. It supports multi-user, multi-device synchronization and provides strong encryption mechanisms to ensure the security and privacy of user data.

overview.zh-CN: PocketBase 是轻量级开源后端服务，提供实时数据库、用户认证和文件存储，简化应用开发流程。

description.en-US: PocketBase is a lightweight, open source Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed to help developers rapidly build and deploy applications. It provides features such as real-time databases, user authentication, file storage, and support for a variety of front-end frameworks to simplify the development process. With PocketBase, developers can focus on application logic without worrying about complex back-end infrastructure.
description.zh-CN: PocketBase 是一个轻量级的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在帮助开发者快速构建和部署应用程序。它提供了实时数据库、用户身份验证、文件存储等功能，支持多种前端框架，简化了开发流程。通过 PocketBase，开发者可以专注于应用逻辑，而无需担心复杂的后端基础设施。

overview.en-US: OpenTelemetry is a collection of APIs, SDKs, and tools. Use it to instrument, generate, collect, and export telemetry data (metrics, logs and traces) to help you analyze your software's performance and behavior.

description.en-US: OpenTelemetry is an open-source telemetry data framework that provides standardized APIs, SDKs, and toolchains for collecting, generating, and exporting application performance data (metrics, logs, traces). As a CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) project, it unifies the format and transport protocols for observability data, and is compatible with various backend analysis tools (such as Prometheus, Jaeger, and SigNoz). Developers can use OpenTelemetry to automatically or manually instrument applications, monitor the operational status of distributed systems, and quickly diagnose performance issues such as latency and errors. Its multi-language support (Go, Java, Python, etc.) and vendor-neutral design make it a core component for monitoring modern cloud-native applications.
description.zh-CN: OpenTelemetry 是一个开源的遥测数据框架，提供标准化的 API、SDK 和工具链，用于收集、生成和导出应用程序性能数据（指标、日志、跟踪）。作为 CNCF（云原生计算基金会）项目，它统一了可观察性数据的格式和传输协议，并与各种后端分析工具（如 Prometheus、Jaeger 和 SigNoz）兼容。开发人员可以使用 OpenTelemetry 自动或手动对应用程序进行instrumentation，监控分布式系统的运行状态，并快速诊断性能问题，如延迟和错误。其多语言支持（Go、Java、Python 等）和供应商中立的设计使其成为监控现代云原生应用程序的核心组件。

title.zh-CN: AI 大模型网关

summary.zh-CN: 支持 200+  AI 模型的网关平台

overview.en-US: Connect, load balance, setup fallbacks and seamlessly manage 100+ AI models using a single consistent API.

description.en-US:
Gateway streamlines requests to 200+ open & closed source models with a unified API. It is also production-ready with support for caching, fallbacks, retries, timeouts, loadbalancing, and can be edge-deployed for minimum latency.

- Blazing fast (9.9x faster) with a tiny footprint (~45kb installed)
- Load balance across multiple models, providers, and keys
- Fallbacks make sure your app stays resilient
- Automatic Retries with exponential fallbacks come by default
- Configurable Request Timeouts to easily handle unresponsive LLM requests
- Multimodal to support routing between Vision, TTS, STT, Image Gen, and more models
- Plug-in middleware as needed
- Battle tested over 300B tokens
- Enterprise-ready for enhanced security, scale, and custom deployments
description.zh-CN:
Gateway 使用统一的 API 简化了对 200+ 开源和闭源模型的请求。它还支持生产就绪，支持缓存、回退、重试、超时、负载均衡，并且可以进行边缘部署以实现最小的延迟。

- 速度极快（9.9 倍），占用空间极小（安装后约 45kb）
- 在多个模型、提供商和密钥之间实现负载平衡
- 回退功能确保您的应用保持弹性
- 默认情况下自动重试指数级回退
- 可配置请求超时，轻松处理无响应的 LLM 请求
- 多模式支持视觉、TTS、STT、图像生成和更多模式之间的路由选择
- 根据需要插入中间件
- 经过超过 300B 令牌的实战测试
- 企业就绪，可增强安全性、扩展性和自定义部署

overview.en-US: Pangolin at its core is a self-hosted tunneled reverse proxy with identity and access management, designed to securely expose private resources through encrypted WireGuard tunnels running in user space. Think self hosted Cloudflare tunnels.
overview.zh-CN: Pangolin 的核心是一个具有身份和访问管理功能的自托管隧道反向代理，旨在通过在用户空间中运行的加密 WireGuard 隧道安全地公开私有资源。

description.en-US: Pangolin is a self-hosted, WireGuard-based tunneling reverse proxy that securely exposes private services to the internet with built-in identity and access management (IAM).  Designed as a self-hosted alternative to Cloudflare Tunnels, it encrypts traffic via user-space WireGuard tunnels, eliminating the need for public IPs or complex firewall rules.  With support for OAuth2, API keys, and multi-factor authentication (MFA), Pangolin ensures secure access control while maintaining full user ownership of data.  Lightweight and cross-platform, it’s ideal for developers, DevOps teams, and enterprises needing private, zero-trust-compliant remote access to internal applications, IoT devices, or hybrid cloud resources—all without relying on third-party cloud providers.
description.zh-CN: Pangolin 是一个自托管的，基于wireguard的隧道反向代理，通过内置的身份和访问管理（IAM）安全地向互联网公开私有服务。作为Cloudflare隧道的自托管替代方案，它通过用户空间的WireGuard隧道加密流量，从而消除了对公共ip或复杂防火墙规则的需求。通过支持OAuth2、API密钥和多因素身份验证（MFA），Pangolin 确保了安全的访问控制，同时保持了数据的完全用户所有权。它轻量级且跨平台，非常适合开发人员、DevOps团队和需要私有的、零信任兼容的远程访问内部应用程序、物联网设备或混合云资源的企业，而无需依赖第三方云提供商。

description.en-US: Typesense is an open-source search platform that provides powerful full-text search capabilities for modern applications. By using advanced natural language processing and machine learning techniques, it can quickly and accurately retrieve and parse large amounts of textual data. Typesense offers an easy-to-use API and user interface, making it easy for developers to integrate search functionality into their applications. Additionally, Typesense supports multiple data sources and languages, and allows users to customize the processing and presentation of search results.
description.zh-CN: Typesense 是一个开源的搜索平台，它为现代应用程序提供强大的全文搜索功能。该软件通过使用先进的自然语言处理和机器学习技术，能够快速准确地检索和解析大量文本数据。 Typesense 提供了易于使用的 API 和用户界面，使得开发者可以轻松集成搜索功能到他们的应用程序中。此外， Typesense 还支持多种数据源和多种语言，并允许用户自定义搜索结果的处理和展示方式。

title.en-US: Fast, typo-tolerant open source search engine

overview.en-US: Secure, store and tightly control access to tokens, passwords, certificates, encryption keys for protecting secrets and other sensitive data using a UI, CLI, or HTTP API.
overview.zh-CN: 使用用户界面、CLI 或 HTTP API 安全、存储和严格控制对令牌、密码、证书、加密密钥的访问，以保护机密和其他敏感数据。

description.en-US: Vault secures, stores, and tightly controls access to tokens, passwords, certificates, API keys, and other secrets in modern computing. Vault handles leasing, key revocation, key rolling, auditing, and provides secrets as a service through a unified API.
description.zh-CN: Vault 是一个开源软件解决方案，用于安全地存储和严格控制现代计算中的令牌、密码、证书、API 密钥和其他秘密的访问。Vault 通过统一的 API 处理租约、密钥撤销、密钥轮换、审计，并提供作为服务的秘密。

description.en-US: This is a repackaged Moodle™ LMS with professional support for your business. Moodle™ LMS is a learning platform designed to provide educators, administrators and learners with a single robust, secure and integrated system to create personalised learning environments.
description.zh-CN: Moodle是一个开源的在线教育系统（慕课）。采用PHP+MySQL开发，界面友好，符合SCORM/AICC标准。功能强大、界面简单、精巧。它是eLearning技术先驱，也是先进在线教学理念和实践的集大成者，已成为全球各大中学院校建立开放式课程系统的首选软件。主要模块：课程管理、作业模块、聊天模块、投票模块、论坛模块、测验模块、资源模块、问卷调查模块、互动评价（workshop）。Moodle具有先进的教学理念，创设的虚拟学习环境中有三个维度：技术管理维度、学习任务维度和社会交往维度，以社会建构主义教学法为其设计的理论基础，它提倡师生或学生彼此间共同思考，合作解决问题。

description.en-US: Teleport prevents phishing by relying on biometrics and machine identity, stops attacker pivots with the Zero Trust architecture, is compatible with everything you have, comes as a cloud service or a self-hosted option and doesn't get in the way of an engineer's productivity.
description.zh-CN: Teleport通过依靠生物识别和机器身份来防止网络钓鱼，使用零信任架构阻止攻击者透视，与你拥有的一切兼容，作为云服务或自托管选项提供，并且不会妨碍工程师的生产力。

overview.en-US: Django is a high-level Python web framework for building secure, scalable web applications quickly.

description.en-US:
Django is an open-source, high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It ships with an ORM, authentication, an admin interface, and built-in protection against common web vulnerabilities.

This package deploys a production-style Django stack: Gunicorn on Python 3.13, PostgreSQL 17, and a named volume for the application code. On first start it creates a default Django project so the admin interface is reachable, and you can then replace it with your own code.

Typical use cases include content sites, internal tools, REST APIs, and data-driven web applications.

title.zh-CN: 威胁预防、安全监控平台

summary.en-US: Wazuh is a free and open source platform used for threat prevention, detection, and response. It is capable of protecting workloads across on-premises, virtualized, containerized, and cloud-based environments.
summary.zh-CN: 威胁预防、安全监控平台

overview.en-US: Wazuh is a free and open source platform used for threat prevention, detection, and response. It is capable of protecting workloads across on-premises, virtualized, containerized, and cloud-based environments.
overview.zh-CN: Wazuh 是一个用于威胁预防、检测和响应的免费开源平台。它能够保护企业内部、虚拟化、容器化和云环境中的工作负载。

description.en-US: Wazuh is an open source security monitoring platform designed to provide a comprehensive security information and event management (SIEM) solution. It monitors and analyzes system logs, file integrity, intrusion detection and compliance in real time.Wazuh collects data on individual hosts through agents and sends it to a centrally managed server for analysis. It supports multiple platforms, including Linux, Windows and macOS, and provides a powerful visualization interface to help users quickly identify security threats. In addition, Wazuh integrates with Elastic Stack for enhanced data analysis and visualization capabilities, enabling security teams to respond more effectively to potential security incidents.
description.zh-CN: Wazuh 是一个开源安全监控平台，旨在提供全面的安全信息和事件管理（SIEM）解决方案。它能够实时监控和分析系统日志、文件完整性、入侵检测和合规性。Wazuh 通过代理在各个主机上收集数据，并将其发送到集中管理的服务器进行分析。它支持多种平台，包括 Linux、Windows 和 macOS，并提供强大的可视化界面，帮助用户快速识别安全威胁。此外，Wazuh 还集成了 Elastic Stack，增强了数据分析和可视化能力，使安全团队能够更有效地响应潜在的安全事件。

summary.zh-CN: 系统监控与报警平台

overview.en-US: An open-source monitoring system with a dimensional data model, flexible query language, efficient time series database and modern alerting approach.
overview.zh-CN: 具有维度数据模型、灵活的查询语言、高效的时间序列数据库和现代警报方法的开源监视系统。

description.zh-CN: Prometheus是 Google 监控系统 BorgMon 类似实现的开源版，整套系统由监控服务、告警服务、时序数据库等几个部分，及周边生态的各种指标收集器（Exporter）组成，是在当下主流的云原生监控告警系统

Its powerful automation and ticket management features increase team efficiency, ensuring quick response and resolution of customer issues. In addition, Zammad provides detailed analytics and reporting tools to help teams monitor and improve their service quality.

overview.zh-CN: WordPress 是一个流行的开源建站平台，市场占有率极高。它以其易用性、易扩展性（ 插件 、模板 、二次开发）、功能强大、美观、搜索引擎友好等特征而广泛流行。

description.en-US:
Style it your way

Design anything you imagine. Start with a blank canvas or choose from a wide variety of themes and patterns. Customize every detail, from color and fonts to layouts and functionality.

Plug in and extend

Make WordPress do whatever you need it to. Add a store, mailing list, portfolio, social feed, analytics; you’re in control with over 55,000 plugins.

Own what you make 

Your content, your design, and your data always belong to you. With WordPress you’re free to tell your story, grow your brand, or simply be yourself.

Create with confidence

Built by an open source community with decades of experience, its passionate contributors are committed to keeping WordPress as stable and secure as possible.
description.zh-CN:
按你的方式设计

设计您想象的任何东西。从一张空白的画布开始，或者从各种各样的主题和图案中进行选择。自定义每个细节，从颜色和字体到布局和功能。

让 WordPress 做任何你需要它做的事。添加商店、邮寄列表、投资组合、社交提要、分析；您可以控制超过 55,000 个插件。

拥有你所做的 

您的内容、设计和数据始终属于您。使用 WordPress，您可以自由地讲述您的故事、发展您的品牌，或者只是做您自己。

由拥有数十年经验的开源社区构建，其热情的贡献者致力于保持 WordPress 尽可能稳定和安全。

overview.en-US: Spring Boot is a Java framework for building production-ready applications. This package provides a ready-to-run workspace with a demo project, Maven, and JDK 21.

description.en-US:
Spring Boot is an open-source Java framework for building standalone, production-grade applications and services with minimal configuration. It provides auto-configuration, an embedded web server, health and metrics endpoints through Actuator, and a large ecosystem of starters.

This package deploys the official Maven image with JDK 21 and bootstraps a default Spring Boot demo project into a persistent workspace volume on first start. The demo exposes a root endpoint, a JSON `/hello` endpoint, and `/actuator/health`. Developers can exec into the container, edit the code under `/workspace`, run `mvn test`, and package the application.

Typical use cases include REST APIs, microservices, internal tools, and as a hands-on workspace for learning and prototyping Spring Boot applications.

description.en-US: Varnish is a high-performance HTTP gas pedal designed to improve the loading speed and performance of websites. It reduces the burden on the server by caching static content such as images, CSS, and JavaScript files, resulting in faster response times.Varnish is configured using the VCL (Varnish Configuration Language), which allows the user to flexibly define caching policies and request processing logic. It is suitable for high-traffic websites and applications that are capable of handling large numbers of concurrent requests.Varnish also supports a wide range of back-end servers that can be used in conjunction with other technologies, such as load balancers and CDNs, to achieve greater scalability and reliability.

It supports various LLM runners, including Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, allowing users to leverage different models based on their specific needs. The platform features a built-in inference engine for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which enhances the capabilities of language models by integrating external knowledge sources, thereby improving the relevance and accuracy of generated responses. Open WebUI is designed for ease of use, with an intuitive interface that simplifies the deployment and management of AI applications. Users can customize the platform to fit their workflows, making it suitable for a wide range of applications, from chatbots to content generation. With its robust architecture and support for multiple AI frameworks, Open WebUI stands out as a powerful solution for organizations looking to implement AI technologies while maintaining control over their data and infrastructure.
description.zh-CN: Open WebUI 是一个可扩展、功能丰富、用户友好的自托管人工智能平台，可完全离线运行，确保数据隐私和安全。它支持各种 LLM 运行程序，包括 Ollama 和 OpenAI 兼容 API，允许用户根据自己的特定需求利用不同的模型。该平台具有一个用于检索-增强生成（RAG）的内置推理引擎，它通过整合外部知识源来增强语言模型的能力，从而提高生成回复的相关性和准确性。开放式 WebUI 设计易于使用，其直观的界面简化了人工智能应用的部署和管理。用户可以根据自己的工作流程定制平台，使其适用于从聊天机器人到内容生成等各种应用。凭借其强大的架构和对多种人工智能框架的支持，Open WebUI 对于希望在保持对数据和基础设施控制的同时实施人工智能技术的企业来说，是一个功能强大的解决方案。
